title: Make the written law match the machine on every door
action: A text review of the two doctrine cells found ten places where the written law overstates what the machine does. Fix all ten, each against the cited live code, and change nothing else. BLOCKING, fix first: planning-reference.md:110 still says the cap helper refuses any behavior_change cell without both verification evidence and a red_failure_evidence 'before'. Both halves are false now — the evidence door is a non-blocking warning (cells.mjs:1969-1974) and the 'before' door is tier-gated to red-first only (cells.mjs:2118, :2150), so a standard-lane behavior cell resolves to existing-targeted-green (cells.mjs:181-183) and is refused by neither. It also contradicts worker-details.md:82. THE PATTERN BEHIND MOST OF THE REST, and the thing to get right everywhere: several surviving refusals are gated on !pendingFeatureVerify, and the pending path is the DEFAULT, so calling them unconditional misleads every worker who takes the default. Gated: the passing-verify requirement (cells.mjs:1913), new_suite_reason (:2014), the ratio refusal (:2047, which becomes a recorded warning on the pending path), and red-first's D3 'before' door (:2150). Ungated, fire on both paths: guardClaimOwnership (:1874), the pending/evidence exclusivity checks (:1893, :1898), the NEEDS_REVISION judge block (:1926), the refactor and formatting new-test-file refusal (:1990), the non-empty files_changed door (:2191), and the high-risk outcome requirement (:2198). Correct these in worker-details.md at :290 (new_suite_reason), :291 (ratio ceiling), :199 (the 'before' door) and :129 (a recorded passing verify is filed under the Both-paths heading while its own clause says the opposite — move it). Also worker-details.md:97-99 claims the marker lands silently on a tiny cell with nothing telling you; that is false for behavior_change, since behaviorEvidenceWarning (cells.mjs:1969-1974) has no lane gate and prints on tiny — only recordedProofWarning (:2182) is lane-gated. TWO CROSS-SKILL CONTRADICTIONS: bee-planning/SKILL.md:76 and planning-reference.md:317 say bugfix and high-risk stay per-cell red-first, which is broader than requiredProofTier at high-risk, where refactor and formatting resolve to suite-green (cells.mjs:165) and test to targeted-green (:170) — bee-executing already states the narrower truth at worker-details.md:148-153, so make bee-planning agree. And worker-details.md:284 says the trailing test cell writes the coverage before the slice may leave swarming, which contradicts bee-planning's new rule that a test cell authoring no test is not a defect, and the door is keyed on the FEATURE, not the slice (state.mjs:2570 takes feature) — restate it as the coverage judgment. TWO D13 ACCURACY FIXES in planning-reference.md:317 and bee-planning/SKILL.md:78: the text describes both refusal kinds as conditional on capped code-touching behavior or api cells existing, but state.mjs:2656-2657 returns 'not-green' from offenders alone with no such requirement — only 'missing' at :2653-2654 carries it. And 'capped green with recorded proof' overstates the predicate: state.mjs:2604-2615 refuses only on status not capped, verify_passed false, or proof 'unrecorded', so a test cell capped on the pending path clears testCellDebt and is caught by featureVerifyDebt instead. Say that. Do not touch source. This cell owns its regen chain — run the plugin skill-tree render, then the onboarding apply, then the release-manifest write, in that order, before capping.

truths: No text claims a cap refuses for missing verification_evidence or for a recorded pass without output
Every refusal the text calls unconditional is ungated in cells.mjs, and every gated one is named as deferred by the pending path
bee-planning and bee-executing agree on red-first's scope at lane high-risk
The trailing test cell is described as owed by the feature and satisfied by the coverage judgment, not by authoring
The D13 description of testCellDebt's two kinds matches state.mjs

artifacts.substantive: the blocking line at :110 corrected plus the D13 and red-first scope fixes
the four gated-door corrections, the tiny-cell warning correction, and the trailing-test-cell restatement

key_links: every corrected sentence traces to a named line in packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs or state.mjs
